cond_0001.intro: The Systems Network Engineer provides direct operations and end-user support for [Company name masked]'s global networks. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, monitoring, and managing the local and wide area networks to ensure maximum uptime for users. The Systems Network Engineer will assist with designing system configurations, documenting and managing the installation of a new network, and maintaining and upgrading existing systems as necessary.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Leading and participating in the installation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and optimization of all network hardware, software, communication links, and routing protocols.
Designing and implementing new network solutions and/or improving the efficiency of current networks.
Installing, configuring and supporting network equipment including routers, proxy servers, switches, WAN accelerators, load balancers, firewalls, DNS, and DHCP.
Procuring network equipment and managing subcontractors involved with network installation.
Configuring firewalls, routers and switches to maximize network efficiency and security.
Maximizing network performance through ongoing monitoring and troubleshooting.
Arranging scheduled upgrades.
Analyze, diagnose, and troubleshoot issues in the network.
Updating network equipment to the latest firmware releases.
Create and maintain network topology documentation of logical network level, physical network design, VLANs, firewalls, and routing protocols.
Reporting network status to key stakeholders.
Provides on-site/remote installation and problem resolution expertise for data related hardware, including modems and multiplexes and expertise for communications management software.
Conducts sophisticated analysis of on-site voice and data equipment, including MS Teams.
Acts as the technical contact point for network communication vendors, coordinating both technical and administrative issues.
Performs facility surveys for network communications and makes recommendations for the layout and location of network components, equipment, cabling, and wiring.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree or recognized equivalent preferably in Computer Science or in a related field, from an accredited university or comparable on-the-job experience.
Proficient with campus network design and troubleshooting including Cisco routers/switches/wireless/802.1x and Palo Alto firewalls.
Thorough understanding of the Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) model.
Working knowledge of IP addressing and subnetting.
Working knowledge of TCP/IP and various routing protocols including BGP, EIGRP, and OSPF, as well as 802.1Q trunking protocol.
Clarity and conciseness in both oral and written communication.
Must be able to provide on-site installation and problem resolution expertise for data related hardware, including modems and multiplexes and expertise for communications management software.
Strong, basic skill in utilizing standard end-user computer applications, including word processing, spreadsheets, presentation graphics, communication packages, network diagramming, etc.
Complete understanding of the basic telecommunications hardware including both voice and data equipment.
Must be able to work in a collaborative team environment.
Preferred Requirements
A minimum of two (2) years' experience on VPN, QOS and VoIP, or five (5) years of experience.
Industry standard certifications such as CCENT, CCNA, Network+.
Extensive knowledge of Network Management tools, including ManageEngine OpManager, Netbox, and SolarWinds network monitoring software.
Capability to effectively motivate co-workers and to lead workgroup teams of one or two other workers.
Working knowledge of the [Company name masked] Health, Safety, Quality and Environmental Management System.

cond_0080.intro: The Systems Network Engineer owns direct operations and end-user support for [Company name masked]'s global networks. This role is accountable for designing, implementing, monitoring, and managing local and wide area networks to ensure maximum uptime for users. The Systems Network Engineer will lead the design of system configurations, direct the documentation and installation of new networks, and drive maintenance and upgrades of existing systems as needed.
cond_0080.responsibilities:
Lead and execute the installation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and optimization of all network hardware, software, communication links, and routing protocols.
Design and implement new network solutions and drive improvements to the efficiency of current networks.
Install, configure, and manage network equipment including routers, proxy servers, switches, WAN accelerators, load balancers, firewalls, DNS, and DHCP.
Procure network equipment and direct subcontractors involved with network installation.
Configure firewalls, routers, and switches to maximize network efficiency and security.
Drive network performance through ongoing monitoring and troubleshooting.
Own the scheduling and execution of network upgrades.
Analyze, diagnose, and resolve network issues.
Update network equipment to the latest firmware releases.
Create and maintain network topology documentation covering logical network level, physical network design, VLANs, firewalls, and routing protocols.
Report network status to key stakeholders.
Deliver on-site and remote installation and problem resolution for data-related hardware, including modems and multiplexers, and for communications management software.
Conduct sophisticated analysis of on-site voice and data equipment, including MS Teams.
Serve as the primary technical contact for network communication vendors, directing both technical and administrative issues.
Perform facility surveys for network communications and make recommendations for the layout and location of network components, equipment, cabling, and wiring.
cond_0080.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree or recognized equivalent, preferably in Computer Science or a related field, from an accredited university, or comparable on-the-job experience.
Proficient with campus network design and troubleshooting including Cisco routers/switches/wireless/802.1x and Palo Alto firewalls.
Thorough understanding of the Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) model.
Working knowledge of IP addressing and subnetting.
Working knowledge of TCP/IP and various routing protocols including BGP, EIGRP, and OSPF, as well as 802.1Q trunking protocol.
Clarity and conciseness in both oral and written communication.
Ability to provide on-site installation and problem resolution expertise for data-related hardware, including modems and multiplexers, and for communications management software.
Strong basic skill in standard end-user computer applications, including word processing, spreadsheets, presentation graphics, communication packages, and network diagramming.
Complete understanding of basic telecommunications hardware including both voice and data equipment.
Ability to effectively motivate co-workers and lead workgroup teams of one or two other workers.
Ability to work in a collaborative team environment.
Preferred Requirements
A minimum of two (2) years' experience with VPN, QoS, and VoIP; five (5) or more years of experience preferred.
Industry standard certifications such as CCENT, CCNA, or Network+.
Extensive knowledge of network management tools including ManageEngine OpManager, Netbox, and SolarWinds network monitoring software.
Working knowledge of the [Company name masked] Health, Safety, Quality and Environmental Management System.

cond_0123.intro: The Systems Network Engineer provides direct operations and end-user support for [Company name masked]'s global networks. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, monitoring, and managing the local and wide area networks to ensure maximum uptime for users. The Systems Network Engineer will regularly communicate with stakeholders and team members while assisting with designing system configurations, documenting and managing the installation of a new network, and maintaining and upgrading existing systems as necessary.
cond_0123.responsibilities:
Leading and actively participating in the installation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and optimization of all network hardware, software, communication links, and routing protocols.
Designing and implementing new network solutions and/or improving the efficiency of current networks.
Installing, configuring and supporting network equipment including routers, proxy servers, switches, WAN accelerators, load balancers, firewalls, DNS, and DHCP.
Procuring network equipment and coordinating directly with subcontractors involved with network installation.
Configuring firewalls, routers and switches to maximize network efficiency and security.
Maximizing network performance through ongoing monitoring and troubleshooting.
Arranging scheduled upgrades.
Analyze, diagnose, and troubleshoot issues in the network.
Updating network equipment to the latest firmware releases.
Create and maintain network topology documentation of logical network level, physical network design, VLANs, firewalls, and routing protocols.
Reporting network status to key stakeholders and walking them through findings as needed.
Provides on-site/remote installation and problem resolution expertise for data related hardware, including modems and multiplexes and expertise for communications management software.
Conducts sophisticated analysis of on-site voice and data equipment, including MS Teams.
Acts as the technical contact point for network communication vendors, initiating and coordinating both technical and administrative issues directly.
Performs facility surveys for network communications and communicates recommendations for the layout and location of network components, equipment, cabling, and wiring.
cond_0123.requirements:
A minimum of two (2) years' experience on VPN, QOS and VoIP is a plus or five (5) years of experience preferred.
Bachelor's degree or recognized equivalent preferably in Computer Science or in a related field, from an accredited university or comparable on-the-job experience.
Industry standard certifications preferred, e.g. CCENT, CCNA, Network+.
Proficient with campus network design and troubleshooting including Cisco routers/switches/wireless/802.1x and Palo Alto firewalls.
Thorough understanding of the Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) model.
Working knowledge of IP addressing and subnetting.
Working knowledge of TCP/IP and various routing protocols including BGP, EIGRP, and OSPF, as well as 802.1Q trunking protocol.
Clarity and conciseness in both oral and written communication.
Extensive knowledge of Network Management tools is a plus. This includes ManageEngine OpManager, Netbox, and SolarWinds network monitoring software.
Must be able to provide on-site installation and problem resolution expertise for data related hardware, including modems and multiplexes and expertise for communications management software.
Strong, basic skill in utilizing standard end-user computer applications, including word processing, spreadsheets, presentation graphics, communication packages, network diagramming, etc.
Complete understanding of the basic telecommunications hardware including both voice and data equipment.
Capability to effectively motivate co-workers and to lead workgroup teams of one or two other workers.
Working knowledge of the [Company name masked] Health, Safety, Quality and Environmental Management System.
Must be able to work in a collaborative team environment.

The Systems Network Engineer will assist with designing system configurations, documenting and managing the installation of a new network, and maintaining and upgrading existing systems as necessary. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with network design, troubleshooting, and infrastructure management.
cond_0131.responsibilities: Leading and participating in the installation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and optimization of all network hardware, software, communication links, and routing protocols. Designing and implementing new network solutions and/or improving the efficiency of current networks. Installing, configuring and supporting network equipment including routers, proxy servers, switches, WAN accelerators, load balancers, firewalls, DNS, and DHCP. Procuring network equipment and managing subcontractors involved with network installation. Configuring firewalls, routers and switches to maximize network efficiency and security. Maximizing network performance through ongoing monitoring and troubleshooting. Arranging scheduled upgrades. Analyze, diagnose, and troubleshoot issues in the network. Updating network equipment to the latest firmware releases. Create and maintain network topology documentation of logical network level, physical network design, VLANs, firewalls, and routing protocols. Reporting network status to key stakeholders. Provides on-site/remote installation and problem resolution expertise for data related hardware, including modems and multiplexes and expertise for communications management software. Conducts sophisticated analysis of on-site voice and data equipment, including MS Teams. Acts as the technical contact point for network communication vendors, coordinating both technical and administrative issues. Performs facility surveys for network communications and makes recommendations for the layout and location of network components, equipment, cabling, and wiring.
cond_0131.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree or recognized equivalent preferably in Computer Science or in a related field, from an accredited university or comparable on-the-job experience.
Proficient with campus network design and troubleshooting including Cisco routers/switches/wireless/802.1x and Palo Alto firewalls.
Thorough understanding of the Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) model.
Working knowledge of IP addressing and subnetting.
Working knowledge of TCP/IP and various routing protocols including BGP, EIGRP, and OSPF, as well as 802.1Q trunking protocol.
Must be able to provide on-site installation and problem resolution expertise for data related hardware, including modems and multiplexes and expertise for communications management software.
Strong, basic skill in utilizing standard end-user computer applications, including word processing, spreadsheets, presentation graphics, communication packages, network diagramming, etc.
Complete understanding of the basic telecommunications hardware including both voice and data equipment.
Clarity and conciseness in both oral and written communication.
Must be able to work in a collaborative team environment.
Preferred Requirements
A minimum of two (2) years' experience on VPN, QOS and VoIP, or five (5) years of experience.
Industry standard certifications, e.g. CCENT, CCNA, Network+.
Extensive knowledge of Network Management tools, including ManageEngine OpManager, Netbox, and SolarWinds network monitoring software.
Capability to effectively motivate co-workers and to lead workgroup teams of one or two other workers.
Working knowledge of the [Company name masked] Health, Safety, Quality and Environmental Management System.

This role is responsible for designing, implementing, monitoring, and managing the local and wide area networks to ensure maximum uptime for users. The Systems Network Engineer will assist with designing system configurations, documenting and managing the installation of a new network, and maintaining and upgrading existing systems as necessary. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp how network systems fit together and why they behave the way they do.
cond_0265.responsibilities: Leading and participating in the installation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and optimization of all network hardware, software, communication links, and routing protocols. Designing and implementing new network solutions and/or improving the efficiency of current networks. Installing, configuring and supporting network equipment including routers, proxy servers, switches, WAN accelerators, load balancers, firewalls, DNS, and DHCP. Procuring network equipment and managing subcontractors involved with network installation. Configuring firewalls, routers and switches to maximize network efficiency and security. Maximizing network performance through ongoing monitoring and troubleshooting. Arranging scheduled upgrades. Analyze, diagnose, and troubleshoot issues in the network. Updating network equipment to the latest firmware releases. Create and maintain network topology documentation of logical network level, physical network design, VLANs, firewalls, and routing protocols. Reporting network status to key stakeholders. Provides on-site/remote installation and problem resolution expertise for data related hardware, including modems and multiplexes and expertise for communications management software. Conducts sophisticated analysis of on-site voice and data equipment, including MS Teams. Acts as the technical contact point for network communication vendors, coordinating both technical and administrative issues. Performs facility surveys for network communications and makes recommendations for the layout and location of network components, equipment, cabling, and wiring.

Working knowledge of TCP/IP and various routing protocols including BGP, EIGRP, and OSPF, as well as 802.1Q trunking protocol. Clarity and conciseness in both oral and written communication. Working knowledge of the [Company name masked] Health, Safety, Quality and Environmental Management System. Must be able to work in a collaborative team environment.

The Systems Network Engineer will lead the design of system configurations, direct the documentation and installation of new networks, and drive maintenance and upgrades of existing systems as needed.
cond_0332.responsibilities:
Lead and execute the installation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and optimization of all network hardware, software, communication links, and routing protocols.
Design and implement new network solutions and drive improvements to the efficiency of current networks.
Install, configure, and manage network equipment including routers, proxy servers, switches, WAN accelerators, load balancers, firewalls, DNS, and DHCP.
Procure network equipment and direct subcontractors involved with network installation.
Configure firewalls, routers, and switches to maximize network efficiency and security.
Drive network performance through ongoing monitoring and troubleshooting.
Own the scheduling and execution of network upgrades.
Analyze, diagnose, and resolve network issues.
Update network equipment to the latest firmware releases.
Create and maintain network topology documentation covering logical network level, physical network design, VLANs, firewalls, and routing protocols.
Report network status to key stakeholders.
Deliver on-site and remote installation and problem resolution for data-related hardware, including modems and multiplexers, and for communications management software.
Conduct sophisticated analysis of on-site voice and data equipment, including MS Teams.
Serve as the primary technical contact for network communication vendors, directing both technical and administrative issues.
Perform facility surveys for network communications and make recommendations for the layout and location of network components, equipment, cabling, and wiring.
cond_0332.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree or recognized equivalent, preferably in Computer Science or a related field, from an accredited university, or comparable on-the-job experience.
Proficient with campus network design and troubleshooting including Cisco routers/switches/wireless/802.1x and Palo Alto firewalls.
Thorough understanding of the Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) model.
Working knowledge of IP addressing and subnetting.
Working knowledge of TCP/IP and various routing protocols including BGP, EIGRP, and OSPF, as well as 802.1Q trunking protocol.
Clarity and conciseness in both oral and written communication.
Ability to provide on-site installation and problem resolution expertise for data-related hardware, including modems and multiplexers, and for communications management software.
Strong basic skill in standard end-user computer applications, including word processing, spreadsheets, presentation graphics, communication packages, and network diagramming.
Complete understanding of basic telecommunications hardware including both voice and data equipment.
Ability to effectively motivate co-workers and lead workgroup teams of one or two other workers.
Ability to work in a collaborative team environment.
Preferred Requirements
A minimum of two (2) years' experience with VPN, QoS, and VoIP; five (5) or more years of experience preferred.
Industry standard certifications such as CCENT, CCNA, or Network+.
Extensive knowledge of network management tools including ManageEngine OpManager, Netbox, and SolarWinds network monitoring software.
Working knowledge of the [Company name masked] Health, Safety, Quality and Environmental Management System.

cond_0357.responsibilities:
Leading and actively participating in the installation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and optimization of all network hardware, software, communication links, and routing protocols.
Designing and implementing new network solutions and/or improving the efficiency of current networks.
Installing, configuring and supporting network equipment including routers, proxy servers, switches, WAN accelerators, load balancers, firewalls, DNS, and DHCP.
Procuring network equipment and coordinating directly with subcontractors involved with network installation.
Configuring firewalls, routers and switches to maximize network efficiency and security.
Maximizing network performance through ongoing monitoring and troubleshooting.
Arranging scheduled upgrades.

cond_0382.intro: The Systems Network Engineer provides direct operations and end-user support for [Company name masked]'s global networks. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, monitoring, and managing the local and wide area networks to ensure maximum uptime for users. The Systems Network Engineer will assist with designing system configurations, documenting and managing the installation of a new network, and maintaining and upgrading existing systems as necessary. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp how network infrastructure fits together and why it behaves the way it does.
cond_0382.responsibilities:
Leading and participating in the installation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and optimization of all network hardware, software, communication links, and routing protocols.
Designing and implementing new network solutions and/or improving the efficiency of current networks.
Installing, configuring and supporting network equipment including routers, proxy servers, switches, WAN accelerators, load balancers, firewalls, DNS, and DHCP.
Procuring network equipment and managing subcontractors involved with network installation.
Configuring firewalls, routers and switches to maximize network efficiency and security.
Maximizing network performance through ongoing monitoring and troubleshooting.
Arranging scheduled upgrades.
Analyze, diagnose, and troubleshoot issues in the network.
Updating network equipment to the latest firmware releases.
Create and maintain network topology documentation of logical network level, physical network design, VLANs, firewalls, and routing protocols.
Reporting network status to key stakeholders.
Provides on-site/remote installation and problem resolution expertise for data related hardware, including modems and multiplexes and expertise for communications management software.
Conducts sophisticated analysis of on-site voice and data equipment, including MS Teams.
Acts as the technical contact point for network communication vendors, coordinating both technical and administrative issues.
Performs facility surveys for network communications and makes recommendations for the layout and location of network components, equipment, cabling, and wiring.

The Systems Network Engineer will assist with designing system configurations, documenting and managing the installation of a new network, and maintaining and upgrading existing systems as necessary.
cond_0417.responsibilities:
Leading and participating in the installation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and optimization of all network hardware, software, communication links, and routing protocols.
Designing and implementing new network solutions and/or improving the efficiency of current networks.
Installing, configuring and supporting network equipment including routers, proxy servers, switches, WAN accelerators, load balancers, firewalls, DNS, and DHCP.
Procuring network equipment and managing subcontractors involved with network installation.
Configuring firewalls, routers and switches to maximize network efficiency and security.
Maximizing network performance through ongoing monitoring and troubleshooting.
Arranging scheduled upgrades.
Analyze, diagnose, and troubleshoot issues in the network.
Updating network equipment to the latest firmware releases.
Create and maintain network topology documentation of logical network level, physical network design, VLANs, firewalls, and routing protocols.
Reporting network status to key stakeholders.
Provides on-site/remote installation and problem resolution expertise for data related hardware, including modems and multiplexes and expertise for communications management software.
Conducts sophisticated analysis of on-site voice and data equipment, including MS Teams.
Acts as the technical contact point for network communication vendors, coordinating both technical and administrative issues.
Performs facility surveys for network communications and makes recommendations for the layout and location of network components, equipment, cabling, and wiring.
cond_0417.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Around 2 years of experience on VPN, QOS and VoIP, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field from an accredited university, or equivalent practical experience.
Working knowledge of campus network design and troubleshooting, including Cisco routers/switches/wireless/802.1x and Palo Alto firewalls.
Familiarity with the Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) model.
Working knowledge of IP addressing and subnetting.
Working knowledge of TCP/IP and various routing protocols including BGP, EIGRP, and OSPF, as well as 802.1Q trunking protocol.
Ability to communicate clearly and concisely in both oral and written form.
Experience providing on-site installation and problem resolution for data related hardware, including modems and multiplexes, and for communications management software.
Background in standard end-user computer applications, including word processing, spreadsheets, presentation graphics, communication packages, and network diagramming.
Familiarity with basic telecommunications hardware, including both voice and data equipment.
Willingness to work collaboratively in a team environment.
Preferred Requirements
Around 5 years of experience, ideally including VPN, QOS and VoIP.
Industry standard certifications such as CCENT, CCNA, or Network+, or willingness to obtain.
Exposure to Network Management tools such as ManageEngine OpManager, Netbox, and SolarWinds network monitoring software.
Ability to help motivate co-workers and lead small workgroup teams of one or two people.
Working knowledge of the [Company name masked] Health, Safety, Quality and Environmental Management System.

The Systems Network Engineer will assist with designing system configurations, documenting and managing the installation of a new network, and maintaining and upgrading existing systems as necessary. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp how network systems fit together and why they behave the way they do.
cond_0625.responsibilities: Leading and participating in the installation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and optimization of all network hardware, software, communication links, and routing protocols. Designing and implementing new network solutions and/or improving the efficiency of current networks. Installing, configuring and supporting network equipment including routers, proxy servers, switches, WAN accelerators, load balancers, firewalls, DNS, and DHCP. Procuring network equipment and managing subcontractors involved with network installation. Configuring firewalls, routers and switches to maximize network efficiency and security. Maximizing network performance through ongoing monitoring and troubleshooting. Arranging scheduled upgrades. Analyze, diagnose, and troubleshoot issues in the network. Updating network equipment to the latest firmware releases. Create and maintain network topology documentation of logical network level, physical network design, VLANs, firewalls, and routing protocols. Reporting network status to key stakeholders. Provides on-site/remote installation and problem resolution expertise for data related hardware, including modems and multiplexes and expertise for communications management software. Conducts sophisticated analysis of on-site voice and data equipment, including MS Teams. Acts as the technical contact point for network communication vendors, coordinating both technical and administrative issues. Performs facility surveys for network communications and makes recommendations for the layout and location of network components, equipment, cabling, and wiring.
cond_0625.requirements: A minimum of two (2) years' experience on VPN, QOS and VoIP is a plus or five (5) years of experience preferred. Bachelor's degree or recognized equivalent preferably in Computer Science or in a related field, from an accredited university or comparable on-the-job experience. Industry standard certifications preferred, e.g. CCENT, CCNA, Network+. Proficient with campus network design and troubleshooting including Cisco routers/switches/wireless/802.1x and Palo Alto firewalls. Thorough understanding of the Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) model. Working knowledge of IP addressing and subnetting. Working knowledge of TCP/IP and various routing protocols including BGP, EIGRP, and OSPF, as well as 802.1Q trunking protocol. Clarity and conciseness in both oral and written communication. Extensive knowledge of Network Management tools is a plus. This includes ManageEngine OpManager, Netbox, and SolarWinds network monitoring software. Must be able to provide on-site installation and problem resolution expertise for data related hardware, including modems and multiplexes and expertise for communications management software. Strong, basic skill in utilizing standard end-user computer applications, including word processing, spreadsheets, presentation graphics, communication packages, network diagramming, etc. Complete understanding of the basic telecommunications hardware including both voice and data equipment. Capability to effectively motivate co-workers and to lead workgroup teams of one or two other workers. Working knowledge of the [Company name masked] Health, Safety, Quality and Environmental Management System. Must be able to work in a collaborative team environment.
cond_0625.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

The Systems Network Engineer will regularly communicate with stakeholders and team members while assisting with designing system configurations, documenting and managing the installation of a new network, and maintaining and upgrading existing systems as necessary.
cond_0645.responsibilities:
Leading and actively participating in the installation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and optimization of all network hardware, software, communication links, and routing protocols.
Designing and implementing new network solutions and/or improving the efficiency of current networks.
Installing, configuring and supporting network equipment including routers, proxy servers, switches, WAN accelerators, load balancers, firewalls, DNS, and DHCP.
Procuring network equipment and coordinating directly with subcontractors involved with network installation.
Configuring firewalls, routers and switches to maximize network efficiency and security.
Maximizing network performance through ongoing monitoring and troubleshooting.
Arranging scheduled upgrades.
Analyze, diagnose, and troubleshoot issues in the network.
Updating network equipment to the latest firmware releases.
Create and maintain network topology documentation of logical network level, physical network design, VLANs, firewalls, and routing protocols.
Reporting network status to key stakeholders and walking them through findings as needed.
Provides on-site/remote installation and problem resolution expertise for data related hardware, including modems and multiplexes and expertise for communications management software.
Conducts sophisticated analysis of on-site voice and data equipment, including MS Teams.
Acts as the technical contact point for network communication vendors, initiating and coordinating both technical and administrative issues directly.
Performs facility surveys for network communications and communicates recommendations for the layout and location of network components, equipment, cabling, and wiring.
cond_0645.requirements:
A minimum of two (2) years' experience on VPN, QOS and VoIP is a plus or five (5) years of experience preferred.
Bachelor's degree or recognized equivalent preferably in Computer Science or in a related field, from an accredited university or comparable on-the-job experience.
Industry standard certifications preferred, e.g. CCENT, CCNA, Network+.
Proficient with campus network design and troubleshooting including Cisco routers/switches/wireless/802.1x and Palo Alto firewalls.
Thorough understanding of the Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) model.
Working knowledge of IP addressing and subnetting.
Working knowledge of TCP/IP and various routing protocols including BGP, EIGRP, and OSPF, as well as 802.1Q trunking protocol.
Clarity and conciseness in both oral and written communication.
Extensive knowledge of Network Management tools is a plus. This includes ManageEngine OpManager, Netbox, and SolarWinds network monitoring software.
Must be able to provide on-site installation and problem resolution expertise for data related hardware, including modems and multiplexes and expertise for communications management software.
Strong, basic skill in utilizing standard end-user computer applications, including word processing, spreadsheets, presentation graphics, communication packages, network diagramming, etc.
Complete understanding of the basic telecommunications hardware including both voice and data equipment.
Capability to effectively motivate co-workers and to lead workgroup teams of one or two other workers.
Working knowledge of the [Company name masked] Health, Safety, Quality and Environmental Management System.
Must be able to work in a collaborative team environment.
